def prototype_census(self):
        """Copy the complete checked ledger for this cursor's successful prefix.

        Includes base-yielded original/decorated types even when channel4
        removes them. Never-yielded base internals and degree/EOF acceptance
        are outside this read-only export. Native/copy failure poisons it.
        """
        if self._failed:
            raise RuntimeError('marked fallback poisoned; no prefix census')
        try:
            self._tick()
            entries = []
            for name, preimage in sorted(self._names.items()):
                self._tick()
                entries.append([name, preimage])
            return self._semantics.tree({
                'schema': 'unit-row-channel4-fallback-prototype-census-v1',
                'version': FALLBACK_VERSION, 'implementation_version': IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION,
                'context': self._context, 'context_sha256': self._context['context_sha256'],
                'input_epoch': self._context['input_epoch'], 'marking_id': self._context['marking_id'],
                'row': self._context['row'], 'state_sha256': self._context['state_sha256'],
                'prototype_census': entries,
                'original_yielded_candidates': self._raw_count, 'yielded_candidates': self._count,
                'marked_removed': self._removed, 'eof_reached': self._done,
                'complete_prefix_census': True,
                'scope': 'CHECKED_STATE_AND_BASE_YIELDED_MARKED_CURSOR_PREFIX',
                'independently_checked': False, 'degree_zero_or_singleton_accepted': False,
                **{k: False for k in FLAGS}}, self._tick)
        except BaseException:
            self._failed = True
            raise
